fields.glossary-text:Staffelmiete: In a graduated rent (Staffelmiete) agreement, the rent is automatically increased at certain times as specified in the contract.
fields.glossary-text:Indexmiete: In an index rent (Indexmiete) agreement, the rent can change according to the price level in the surrounding area. This is done to adjust the rent to economic changes.
fields.glossary-text:Nettokaltmiete: Net cold rent (Nettokaltmiete) refers to the base rent without additional operating costs, such as heating or hot water costs. Your net rent should be specified in your rental contract.

fields.Informiere deine Nachbar*innen Text 1: If your rent is too high, there's a good chance that your neighbors your neighbors feel the same way. However, you will often not even be aware that they can take action against high rents.
fields.Informiere deine Nachbar*innen Text 2: We have prepared a few things for you that you can use to inform your neighbors and network with them. Whether it's a note in the hallway, a flyer in the letterbox or a call for a tenants' meeting - there's something for everyone here.
fields.Schaffe ein Bewusstsein für die Mietenkr: Create awareness of the rental crisis
Let your friends and acquaintances know how outrageously high your rent is. With our Sharepics you can inform your family, friends and acquaintances about mietencheck.de and invite them to join you.
fields.Engagiere dich Text: Numerous tenants have already joined forces to defend themselves against cheeky landlords. Especially if you live with a large housing company, there is a good chance that there are already networks of active landlords. We are also always happy to hear from people who want to join us in the fight against the rent crisis.

fields.Bester/Schlechtester Fall Erklärung Text: Since you indicated “I'm not sure” for some questions, the maximum rent allowed for your apartment may vary. We therefore calculate two scenarios:
The scenario in which you have to pay the least rent, i.e. all questions in which you have indicated “I'm not sure”, are in your favor.
The scenario in which you have to pay the most rent, i.e. all questions in which you have indicated “I'm not sure”, are not in your favor.
fields.Du kannst dich gegen deine zu hohe Miete: You can fight back against your high rent! Not only will you save money every month, but you will also do something to combat rising rents in our city!
fields.Beratung durch Mieterverein Titel: Free advice from the Berlin tenants' association
fields.Beratung durch Mieterverein Text 1: Tenants' associations, such as the Berlin tenants' association, offer their members regular free consultations with lawyers in all Berlin districts.
fields.Beratung durch Mieterverein Text 2: If you were already a member of the tenants' community or the tenants' association before you signed your rental agreement, then the legal costs insurance will even cover the costs if your case goes to court.
fields.Beratung durch Mieterverein Text 3: If you become a new member now, then you can definitely take advantage of the free advice services there, but you have no insurance if your case goes to court.
fields.Beratung durch Mieterverein Text 4: In addition, the tenants' associations are the political interest groups of us tenants. So it makes sense for every tenant to become a member.
fields.Beratung durch Bezirke Titel: Free tenant advice from Berlin districts
fields.Beratung durch Bezirke Text 1: All Berlin districts have a tenant advice service that residents of the district can use free of charge. Tenancy law experts can advise you there on your results or next steps.
fields.Beratung durch Bezirke Text 2: However, the districts do not offer legal representation in court. If your landlord refuses to reduce your rent, you can decide to assert your rights in court. To do this, you must hire a lawyer for a fee.
fields.Beratung durch Bezirke Text 3: To make an appointment for tenancy law advice, click on "More information" for an overview of the consultation times and locations in your district.
fields.Beratung durch Rechtsanwalt Text 1: You can also hire a lawyer directly to check your results and answer any questions you may have. However, this advice is subject to a fee. You may be able to apply for legal aid for this.
fields.Beratung durch Rechtsanwalt Text 2: You can also hire a lawyer to enforce your rights in court if your landlord refuses to reduce your rent. You bear the risk if you lose and do not have legal protection insurance to cover the costs.
fields.Beratung durch Rechtsanwalt Text 3: We have prepared a list of specialized lawyers for you, along with an overview of possible costs and information on legal aid.
fields.Beratung durch Drittanbieter Titel: Paid advice from a third-party provider
fields.Beratung durch Drittanbieter Text 1: You can also hire a commercial provider, such as Conny, to enforce the rent cap for you. The advantage of these commercial providers is that they bear the cost risk for you. If, for example, legal proceedings are initiated, the providers will bear the costs.
fields.Beratung durch Drittanbieter Text 2: The disadvantage of these providers, however, is that they keep a portion of the money you save in the future. This portion is particularly high if you pay significantly too much rent.
fields.Beratung durch Drittanbieter Text 3: There are also other things to consider with Conny: Conny does not accept all cases in which you pay too much rent. In some cases, it can take a very long time for Conny to process your case.
fields.Beratung durch Drittanbieter Text 4: Important: Once you have commissioned Conny, you can no longer decide to take action on your own. Conny demands high compensation amounts if you want to withdraw from the contract at a later date.

strings.0cb2a7: Please note: Just being in good condition is not enough. Signs of a representative and decorative staircase or entrance area are, for example: carpet runners throughout, marble, mirrors, elaborate wall and ceiling design.
strings.78a5d2: Is low-threshold access to the building (max. 1 step) and the apartment (max. 1 step) possible?
strings.11158c: Note: It is not important that you are dependent on low-threshold access.
strings.aece76: Is the building in which the flat is located in poor condition?
strings.5e9edc: Is the building in which the flat is located in very good condition?
strings.0e6b41: The overall impression should be that of a recently renovated house. This can be assumed if both the façade and the roof give the impression of being freshly renovated.
strings.83bd99: Is there a lift that can be used to reach the flat?
strings.d38154: Is the flat on the fourth floor or lower?
strings.1bc3c5: Note: The ground floor does not count in the numeric labelling of the floors.
strings.1dcfc8: Is the flat on the fifth floor or higher?
strings.4ce264: Is it possible to park bicycles on the property?
strings.3577ff: Is there an easily accessible, lockable room for storing bicycles?
strings.c253b4: Please note: this room must be large enough to provide enough space for all the residents using it.
strings.b90fa5: Are there sufficient parking spaces for bicycles on the property where you can safely lock your bike?
strings.b6d52a: Note: This does not apply to bike racks that only allow the front wheels to be locked, as these are not considered safe. There must also be sufficient space for all tenants to park their bikes.
strings.ddc793: Is there a private cellar, attic or storage room belonging to the flat?
strings.5da206: Is there a private cellar or storage room belonging to the flat?
strings.d3c046: This storage room does not count, if you pay an extra rent for it.
strings.c99b9e: Does the landlord offer additional rooms?
strings.2a29aa: This includes, for example, communal rooms, a communal kitchen or a fitness room.
strings.c5e954: Is there a free garage or parking space that comes with the flat at no extra cost?
strings.72caa0: Is the flat in a side wing of a densely built estate?
strings.14d429: This is the case if all the windows look out onto a closed backyard where the other houses are only a few metres away.
strings.37cad0: Do you know the energy consumption indicator (“Energieverbrauchskennwert”) or the energy requirement indicator (“Energiebedarfskennwert”) of your home?
strings.62b023: If you know both values, it is best to select the energy consumption indicator (“Energieverbrauchskennwert”). These values must be on the energy performance certificate that was shown to you before you moved in.
strings.4df9a3: Yes, I know the energy consumption value
strings.b9f849: Yes, but only the energy requirement value
strings.6e7495: What is the energy consumption indicator (“Energieverbrauchskennwert”) of the flat?
strings.35b978: What is the energy requirement indicator (“Energiebedarfskennwert”) of the flat?
strings.a6f6ef: What is the energy requirement indicator (“Energiebedarfskennwert”) of the flat?
strings.da8a45: Was the heating system in the flat installed before 1984?
strings.d7e83a: Note: The heating system only refers to the appliance that produces the heat, e.g. gas heating systems, oil heating systems or heat pumps. The radiators are not part of the heating system.
strings.d07990: Was the heating system in the flat installed before 1988?
strings.f656cf: Was the heating system in the flat installed before 1995?
strings.0879c7: Was the heating system in the flat installed after 1.1.2009?
strings.f9c97f: Is the thermal insulation of the flat in a poor condition?
strings.54afc1: Indications for this can be, that there is a draught in the home or that it gets cold again very quickly after you turn off the heating in winter.
strings.dab7e1: Is there thermal insulation in addition to the original building substance?
strings.c23788: Is the flat in a particularly quiet area?
strings.18d545: Please note: a simple, quiet residential street in a 30 km/h zone is not sufficient. Only a location next to a quiet park or in a street with special (structural) traffic calming measures can be considered. There must be no other sources of noise apart from road traffic, such as restaurants.
strings.c00014: Is the flat in a particularly noisy area?
strings.577bc7: This applies, for example, if the apartment is located on a main road, a noisy railroad line or near an airport in an approach path. Noise from industry and restaurants or music can also be considered. However, these must not only occur temporarily (e.g. construction sites/street parties), but must be long-term and regular.
strings.bdb63b: Is the flat regularly and significantly affected by noises or odours from nearby businesses?
strings.b28040: Note: This does not refer to general traffic noise, but to noise caused by commercial delivery and customer traffic, for example
strings.2278cf: Is the flat in a particularly odour-contaminated location?
strings.4f23ce: Is the property on which your apartment is located designed to be inviting?
strings.d57621: This is the case, for example, if there are green spaces with landscaped paths or benches and rest areas. These must also not be in a neglected state.
strings.bc5909: This is the case, for example, if there are green spaces with landscaped paths, playgrounds or benches and rest areas. These must also not be in a neglected state.
strings.80f073: Is there an unkempt, open rubbish storage area on the property?
strings.7a78b0: Is there a well-maintained rubbish storage area on the property of the house with a design that obstructs the view?
strings.be0a5a: Please note: This applies even if this comes with costs that have to be paid in addition to the rent.
strings.db8d77: Is there a communal garden that can be used together with other tenants?
strings.3c9fb8: Please note: This only applies if no additional payment is required for the garden.
strings.6e9a4f: Is it possible to park bikes on the property?
strings.cdd30a: Please note: It is sufficient that it is generally possible to park bikes somewhere on the property, e.g. in the backyard or a bike cellar. There does not have to be an extra bike stand or anything similar.
strings.382ea6: Is the apartment located in a rather unkempt area or in one of the following so-called crime-ridden locations (Kriminalitätsbelastete Orte)?
strings.fa2746: According to the police, the following locations are considered crime-ridden: Wrangelkiez in the vicinity of Görlitzer Park, Kottbusser Tor, Hermannstraße in the immediate vicinity of Neukölln S-Bahn station, Donaukiez in the vicinity of Hermannplatz.
strings.c85c95: Is the flat close to Kurfürstendamm or in Berlin Mitte and in a prestigious and high-quality location?
strings.ccf64c: Please note: the assessment of the residential area as good according to the rent index is not sufficient.
strings.8fdfdf: Are there villa-type apartment blocks in the vicinity of the house?
strings.e32dbb: Is there a parking space for the car provided by the landlord near the flat?
strings.a9ab62: Please note: The car park may also be subject to a charge
